Notes

Occasional writing from Reem Glasco, LPC-S, on the things that come up often enough in the room to be worth setting down once: boundaries, what the nervous system is doing, trauma work, and the practical business of being a therapist in Texas.

All notes

How to Set Healthy Boundaries

Five steps to setting boundaries that hold: identify your limits, say them plainly, read your own feelings, and get help if they keep collapsing.

Where the rest of the writing went

The old site's best-performing pages were not its blog posts but its explanations of how the methods work. Those have become their own pages rather than archived posts, which is why the modality writing now lives under Approach and not here.

  • Somatic Experiencing, which absorbed both old SE posts
  • NARM, from the old NARM page
  • EMDR and IFS-informed EMDR
  • The Texas LPC licensure guide, which did not exist before

Psychology Today profile

Reem Glasco is a Licensed Professional Counselor Supervisor in Texas, license 66562. Complaints about a Texas licensee go to the Texas Behavioral Health Executive Council, 1-800-821-3205. Nothing on this site is therapy, supervision, or a substitute for either. If you are in immediate danger, call 911. For a mental health crisis, call or text 988 for the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline.
